mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE create_time >= #{start}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE create_time >= #{start} AND create_time < #{end}

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS d, IFNULL(SUM(total_price), 0) AS v FROM orders WHERE status IN (1,2,3) AND create_time >= #{start} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY d
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS d, COUNT(*) AS v FROM orders WHERE create_time >= #{start} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY d
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS d, COUNT(*) AS v FROM `user` WHERE create_time >= #{start} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY d

SELECT c.id AS id, c.name AS name, IFNULL(SUM(oi.total_price), 0) AS `value` FROM order_item oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN product p ON oi.product_id = p.id JOIN category c ON p.category_id = c.id WHERE o.status IN (1,2,3) AND o.create_time >= #{start} GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY `value` DESC
SELECT status AS status, COUNT(*) AS `count` FROM orders WHERE create_time >= #{start} GROUP BY status ORDER BY status

SELECT oi.product_name AS name, IFNULL(SUM(oi.total_price), 0) AS `value`, IFNULL(SUM(oi.quantity), 0) AS `count` FROM order_item oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status IN (1,2,3) AND o.create_time >= #{start} GROUP BY oi.product_name ORDER BY `value` DESC LIMIT #{limit}
